article.story: MISSOULA, Mont. -- — Money Williams had 14 points to help Montana hold off Idaho 73-68 on Saturday night. Williams shot 4 of 10 from the field, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 4 from the free-throw line for the Grizzlies (14-11, 8-4 Big Sky Conference). Te'Jon Sawyer totaled 13 points and eight rebounds. Tyler Thompson scored 12 on 4-for-6 shooting from 3-point range. Biko Johnson finished with 22 points and six rebounds for the Vandals (13-11, 5-6). Jack Payne added 12 points and Isaiah Brickner had nine points and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
